projects.name: Booking Service
details: Developed a Full-Stack Hotel Booking and Property Management Platform with a responsive
Angular frontend and a scalable Spring Boot microservices backend. Built Angular
standalone components for hotel search, filters, room availability, and booking flow, integrating
backend services using REST APIs, RxJS, and HTTPClient. Implemented JWT-based
authentication, secure payment gateway integration, notifications, PDF invoice generation.
Used Hibernate/JPA for ORM, MySQL for database design, AWS S3 for image and document
storage. Followed Agile methodology, used Git for version control and Postman for API testing.

projects.name: Management System
details: Developed a Spring Boot—based Payroll Management System to automate salary
Processing, employee compensation, and payroll reporting for an IT organization. The system
features JWT, role-based access control and secure data handling for HR, Admin, and
Employee users. Focused on improving efficiency, transparency and data integrity through modular architecture and optimized backend design.

projects.name: Travel Agency
details: Developed an Online Travel Agency System, a Spring Boot—based web application that enables
users to search, book and manage bus travel services with secure authentication and real-time
booking updates. Integrated OTP and JWT-based authentication, payment gateway processing
for seamless and secure user experience. Built a robust backend using Java 8, Spring  Boot,
Hibernate, JPA, and MySQL , ensuring optimized performance and reliable data management
through well-structured entity relationships and efficient queries.

modules.
